objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: every grouping of the square torus's law-(12, 12) automaton invariant under a sublattice of index at most 8 compatible with the 24 x 24 torus (and index at most 6 on the 12 x 12 and 16 x 16 tori), read for being a network, for the plain first need of every ring at every target, and, where on time, for the rings' homology classes and the ring graph's balls, testing that every on-time grouping is a family of parallel lines with a cyclic ring graph.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-10 (exploratory, exact; frozen contract pre-registered in 543d364ab): of 2,070,428 periodic groupings of the square torus's law-(12,12) automaton (sublattice index up to 8 on the 24 x 24 and 16 x 16 tori, up to 6 on the 12 x 12), 24,060 are networks and 1,302 are on time, every one a family of parallel lines of one homology class (p, q) (H1; classes (1,0), (1,1), (1,2), (1,3), (1,5), (1,7), (3,5) up to symmetry), whose ring graph is a cycle (H2).
title: Periodic groupings of the square torus's automaton: a census
